faq.question: What is Pixel Art Avatar Icon Generator?
faq.answer: Pixel Art Avatar Icon Generator is an external pixel-style chibi character icon maker from icongenerators.net.

faq.question: Is this tool owned by My Square Face Icon?
faq.answer: No. This page links to the external generator with source attribution. The original tool and its assets remain on icongenerators.net.

faq.question: Why does the embedded generator not load?
faq.answer: The original site currently sends browser security headers that allow the page to be framed only by itself. Use the Open Original Page button to launch it directly.

faq.question: Can a VPN, proxy, or network filter stop the generator from opening?
faq.answer: Yes. VPNs, proxy tools, privacy extensions, school networks, company networks, or DNS filters may block the external page. Try turning off the proxy for this page, switching networks, or opening the original page directly.

faq.question: Does this page copy the generator assets?
faq.answer: No. This site does not host or copy the original generator files, artwork, comments, or source code.

faq.question: Can I use it on mobile?
faq.answer: It may work, but detailed avatar controls are usually easier on desktop or in landscape mode.
